title: About CAPIT | Data, Methodology, and Mission
description: Learn what CAPIT is, how the data works, what the token does, and where the project draws clear claim boundaries.
headline: About CAPIT
body: CAPIT is a data-first website and non-inflationary token project built securely on the Base network. Our mission is to bring public-record transparency to environmental cleanup through blockchain technology.

sections.heading: Why This Exists
sections.body: Well-plugging information is highly fragmented across varying agency systems, state definitions, and update schedules. CAPIT aggregates this information into one transparent public experience so users can understand what is being counted, where it came from, and when it was last verified.

sections.heading: How CAPIT Works
sections.body: CAPIT follows a simple five-step deterministic model.
bullets: Collect: CAPIT gathers public source records from published state-level agency systems and approved datasets.
Normalize: CAPIT organizes fields so users can compare infrastructure records across varying jurisdictions.
Verify: CAPIT applies strict publication rules, source checks, and revision logic before physical remediation records appear publicly.
Publish: CAPIT displays provenance, freshness, and caveats alongside visible data.
Link: CAPIT links protocol activity strictly to the approved 1:1 minting methodology on the Base network.

sections.heading: What CAPIT Is Not
sections.body: CAPIT is not a government registry, nor is it a substitute for reading the underlying source agency record. CAPIT serves as a strict environmental infrastructure receipt representing physical remediation. It is explicitly not a carbon credit, offset, or speculative instrument. Tokens do not imply ownership of a well, environmental attributes, or rights to public remediation funds.

sections.heading: Governance and Roadmap
sections.body: Governance details, protocol permissions, and future roadmap commitments will appear here once approved by legal and engineering review. Until then, CAPIT limits all functionality to publicly documented, verification-based tracking.
